agent: the MCP agent runtime connected to the seal-host child transport

evidence_sources.description: seal policy payload represented by this deployment inventory

broker.conditional_on: the agent runtime has no direct handle or credential for the same effect outside seal

declared_paths.mechanism: JSON-RPC tool calls sent through seal-host stdin to its configured child
declared_paths.reason: the deployment starts the child behind seal-host's stdio transport

declared_paths.mechanism: direct writes to the container /tmp tmpfs
declared_paths.reason: the deployment mounts /tmp read-write and seal does not broker ordinary filesystem syscalls
declared_paths.conditional_on: the agent runtime executes in this container with access to the declared /tmp mount

category_enumeration.method: enumerate effect-capable tool names from the seal policy (excluding unconditional deny), then add deployment-declared direct handles
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: the policy is not an authoritative manifest of every tool exposed by the child runtime

category_enumeration.method: read the declared seal-host child transport; no live file-descriptor inspection
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: v0 cannot inspect the live agent process for additional sockets, pipes, or inherited descriptors

category_enumeration.method: look for deployment declarations; no live process or syscall inspection
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: the deployment files do not establish whether the agent runtime exposes subprocess or shell execution

category_enumeration.method: hash the compose declaration containing network_mode:none; no live namespace or policy inspection
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: v0 cannot verify that the declared network isolation is applied to the live agent runtime

category_enumeration.method: enumerate declared container mounts; no live mount namespace or open-descriptor inspection
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: undeclared mounts, inherited descriptors, and runtime-created paths cannot be excluded

category_enumeration.method: look for deployment declarations; no scheduler API or live process inspection
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: v0 cannot determine whether the agent runtime holds timers, cron handles, queues, or delayed-job APIs

category_enumeration.method: declaration only; the runtime object graph is not introspectable by seal-host
category_enumeration.unknown_reason: seal-host cannot enumerate effectful objects already held inside the agent runtime

limitations: prove that the configured inventory equals total agent reachability
discover undeclared direct tool handles automatically
inspect live credentials, environment variables, file descriptors, namespaces, or network policy
distinguish one hidden path from many hidden paths behind an UNKNOWN sentinel
treat BROKERED as SAFE or as proof that every call will be allowed
authenticate the signing key owner without an externally supplied expected public key
